title: Localization at a prime, residue field of a prime, fibre ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $\mathfrak p\subset R$ a prime ideal. The *localization* $R_{\mathfrak p}=S^{-1}R$, $S=R\setminus\mathfrak p$, is the ring of fractions $r/s$ ($r\in R$, $s\in S$, with $r/s=r'/s'$ iff $u(rs'-r's)=0$ for some $u\in S$), with the ring map $R\to R_{\mathfrak p}$, $r\mapsto r/1$; it is a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$. The *residue field* of $\mathfrak p$ is $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=R_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$, an $R$-algebra. For an $R$-algebra $\Lambda$ (a ring map $R\to\Lambda$) the *fibre ring* of $\Lambda$ over $\mathfrak p$ is the tensor product of $R$-algebras $\Lambda\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$, a $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$-algebra; it is isomorphic to $\Lambda_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak p\Lambda_{\mathfrak p}$, $\Lambda_{\mathfrak p}$ the localization of $\Lambda$ at the image of $R\setminus\mathfrak p$.
